snippet.title: Ferris Mueller's Day Off - Intro and Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Glitch Games is excited to announce Ferris Mueller's day off. A colourful, hand drawn adventure game full of head scratching puzzles and interesting characters. 

So join us now for some good old fashioned mule hunting fun.
